description:
SmartCV: Computer vision project that reads MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls footage from the game (if possible) or using OBS.
Developed by Team Polygon

PROS:
- Does not require installation of mods on your game

CONS:
- Requires additional SmartCV app to run
- Can be slightly inaccurate with detecting round ends
- Player tags not OCR'd yet
- Team (4-char) reporting not wired yet; leader character only
